# 1.2.113 - the GM's word on a found body, the killer behind a "?", the trial curtain in one cut, Scrum Debate's camps, the texts in two languages and the checks that hold them, and the module in smaller files

One train on 1.2.112 (8834a9b9's release, tag v1.2.112). Seven stages of the ledger ship here, as one chain: E54 (the
file split), E38 (two GMs and a player who was away), E55 (the CSS consolidation), E25 and E71 (the texts), E57 (the
text checks that now block, and the handbooks' help links) and E102 (tooltips). Beside them, the lines merged into the
1.2.113 tree: the fixes of the owner's table on 1.2.112 (hot-112, bugs-113, fix-113b to fix-113s, body-113), the privacy
lines (pv-doors, pv-cards, pv-snap, leak-pm), the audit of 1.2.113 and its findings, compat-113 (Daggerheart 2.12.8),
E69's C6-C8 (in fix-113o), E26's preparation (fonts and their licences), E56's part 1, E59, E39, E40 and E43's tests,
the trial curtain's hand-back (r4420), needsCode (77 fixes the text lines found in the code), the handbooks for this
version, and the tier-2 restore (t2-restore, t2-rest). From v1.2.112 to 93f91a60, the tree before this release commit:
636 commits, 106 of them merges, 105 on the tree itself (`git rev-list --count`, `--merges --count` and
`--first-parent --count` over v1.2.112..93f91a60).

E56, E109, E59, E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 are planned for 1.2.115 and E110 for 1.2.114 (tools/stages.json): what
of them is in this tree is merged but not marked shipped.

In plain words:

**Death and the body.**
- **A body seen by two waits for the GM's word** (the owner's decisions A and B of 13.11.2026): two witnesses no longer
  start the announcement. The primary GM is asked: **Announce** runs the discovery, **Not yet** (the default) keeps it
  waiting. The GM's discovery window names the bodies that wait, and the GM panel's Next line names them too. Every
  witness is told at once, privately, as a lone finder is, and hears the discovery sound on their own browser.
- **A death makes three things, and now two of them show**: the student's own token stays the corpse, the dead
  player's Spectator gets its token, and the body tile (the third thing the owner saw at the table, drawn with the
  token's picture) is now laid unseen, its caption moved to the corpse. Two GMs at once make one Spectator, not two. A
  body tile laid by 1.2.112 or before is made unseen once by the clause `bodyTilesUnseen` (below).
- **One sound per moment and browser at a death**, the most specific winning: the victim's player hears the death fade
  alone, and an execution plays its own sound.

**E69, the killer behind a "?"** (C6-C8, the owner's decision of 13.11.2026):
- An opening on Hope, or a critical, of a direct murder hides the killer: their tokens show a "?" with the mystery
  figure until they reveal themselves, and the look is kept by the GMs alone.
- Every copy of the incident but the killer's own holds no killer; the victim is told "Someone is moving on you".
- The masked killer talks in a silent voice room of their own.
- **Listen's eavesdrop**: after a good Listen roll (14+, or a critical) the listener is sent into that room's voice
  channel, the card first.
- **Echoes**: a row of the Infiltrate window, one action and no roll, that names the nearest room, by crossings, with a
  living student of another player in it; struck through in an Eclipse.
- **A season reset ends a standing mask** (2b43ffde): before it, a reset while a killer stood masked left their tokens
  a "?" with nothing left to give their look back.

**The trial curtain.**
- One cut from closed to open.
- The curtain stays closed until this browser has drawn the next scene.
- No blink on a slow table (R4420): the curtain's end waited only for its own timer, so a page whose main thread
  stalled could drop the closed copies while the live curtain was still rising. The end now waits for the hand-back
  as well, at the trial's entry and exit both.
- An exit that switches no scene does not hold the closed curtain.

**The rest of the trial and the day.**
- **Scrum Debate in three phases** (the owner's word of 13.11.2026): Sides, then Camps confer (120 s), each camp in a
  voice room of its own on LiveKit, then the debate. Skip ends a phase, +30 s extends it. Without the LiveKit module, or
  with regional voice off, Confer runs as a timer.
- **The zone modes named** on the HUD and the Event card, each with its own line under the name.
- **The day's boards where the owner put them**: the start-of-day board at the start of the Morning Eclipse, the
  end-of-day board after the Night Eclipse (at the start of Night).
- **The Despair a gift of Hope owes** is drawn for the GMs: the owed skulls dimmer, in a dashed box, the debt on the
  count's tooltip, and the giving GM is told. A lapsed Bounty's Despair goes back, and the lapse is told.
- **A Monocub's tunnel crossing and its Eclipse door moves cost nothing**, on every road.
- **The Rest window greys a rest its character cannot pay for**, with the price as the reason.
- **The case map** pans with the middle button, its columns stand 200 px apart, and a deduction stands at the middle of
  what it rests on.

**Sheets and windows.**
- The sheet's left column no longer scrolls sideways when the Experience list is empty; only the module's own rows
  stand in the Equipped list; the sheet's header keeps the name on a line of its own at any width.
- The Facilities tile is dimmed only when no row of its window can be taken.
- The open tab of every tab bar is marked again under the glass.
- **Take from the Body** opens an action window on the shared two-column layout.
- **The GM panel's** top lines are centred under Stained Glass, and the panel no longer lists the case's planned
  Remnants ("The case waits for ...").
- A Planned Truth Bullet plans its picture, and a Truth Bullet can be given to **Everyone**.

**The texts, in English and Polish** (E25, E71, needsCode): the module's sentences rewritten to the text guide
(docs/text-style.md) in both languages, and 77 places in the code where a text could not be right (a list, a count, a
placeholder) fixed. The handbooks, all six, rewritten for this version; the GM windows' "?" opens the handbook at the
right section (E57). **E102**: 197 tooltip keys (`DRPG.Tips`, 135 at 1.2.112), the Investigation and the case among
them (C6).

**Privacy.**
- **The nine fixes of the privacy lines** (the owner's rules of 13.11.2026):
  - doors: a bedroom's owner hears of a forced door, a careless pick, a breach or a repair on walking back in, by every
    road they come back by; the room sees who works its doors; a knock is heard behind a barricade; Support names its
    buyer.
  - cards: a Despair Call's public card names no secret project and no Chained room; an open Frisk shows the room the
    pockets turned out; Palm and an unseen Frisk show the room a hand the victim catches.
  - snapshots: a player sees a project, a found project and an erased trace as last seen; a finished project's tint and
    a player's Call picker follow the same snapshot.
- **A secret project's murder mark and room** (leak-pm): until 1.2.113 any player's browser held, in the module's world
  data, which secret project is an indirect murder, and the room of a secret project whose token is not on the map;
  both are now kept by the GMs and sent only to the players in on the project and to Spectators. (Where a project's
  token stands still shows its room to every browser.)
- **Two GMs, and a player who was away** (E38): a Truth Bullet given on a second GM and the primary's find of the same
  trace make one copy, not two; a private card a GM whispered to a player who was offline reaches them when they come
  back.

**Compatibility.**
- **Daggerheart 2.12.8**: the Projects tray names itself where 2.12.8's header draws no title; the Actions resource
  survives 2.12.8's clean-up of optional resources; the roll window reads its character where 2.12.8 keeps it; a
  disabled field in Foundry's and other modules' windows reads as disabled, in both themes. Verified stays 2.12.8.
- A dead student no player owns (an NPC) gets no Spectator and no token.
- A held Hope slot is drawn held after a repaint without a render.

## Before installing

- **Two world migrations**, each once, on the primary GM:
  - `liftSecretProjectMarks` (since 1.2.113): a secret project's `indirectMurder` mark and its `room` move out of
    projectMeta (world data every browser holds) into the GMs' store, after the GM store's copies have arrived; then
    every player who sees a secret project is sent their sight again.
  - `bodyTilesUnseen` (since 1.2.113): every body tile on every scene laid at a visible alpha is set to 0. Nothing else
    of the tile changes. A world with none says nothing.
- **New stored data**: eight client settings, the GM stores' copies on a browser: `gmFoundDone`, `seenProjects`,
  `gmPendingBodies`, `gmBodiesHeard`, `gmEavesdrops`, `mineEavesdrops`, `gmMasks`, `gmBedroomNotes`.
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 5735 to 6054 keys: 388 added, 69 removed, 1877 changed in wording (counted on the
  flattened files, v1.2.112 against 93f91a60). A world's words change in both languages.
- **Fonts**: every font the module ships has its licence text in fonts/ (Special Elite, VT323, and the pixel face from
  Press Start 2P), and the modified pixel face keeps no reserved name (E26's preparation).

## Repository

- **E54, the file split**: seven families cut into smaller files by tools/e54/split.mjs (the sheet, the windows, the
  settings windows, the Key Remnants, the clean-up's reshape, the chapter, the glass), the suite's readers pointed at
  the new files and the comments swept to say where the code stands; 253 module files in scripts/ (230 at 1.2.112, tests
  aside).
- **E55, the CSS consolidation**: a selector stated more than once in a sheet made one rule, 22 surfaces, a commit each;
  the glass's ink at seven alphas as tokens; one brush definition. Measured in Chromium: style-freeze and style-sweep 0
  differences after each step (style-sweep 628 readings, style-freeze 1304); look-freeze 34 differences, every one a
  masked glyph's `font-family` under Legacy (the old Font Awesome names gone), accepted by surface.
- **E56 part 1**: `no-unused-vars` is an error in `npm run lint` (74 found on 123f8242, removed, not silenced); the
  keys guard, `node tools/check.mjs keys`, is red on a key of lang/en.json nothing reads (0 dead of 5794 on 123f8242).
- **The text checks now block**: twelve that only reported at 1.2.112 are `mode: "fail"` in scripts/tests-text.mjs, T4,
  T5, T7, T8, T11, T12, T13, T15, T16, T21, T24 and T25 (E57 and the text lines), each at 0 on this tree;
  `node tools/check.mjs rules` holds the handbooks' rule sentences to the code (E57).
- **E39, E40, E43 and E59's tests**: E40's two Blackened in 18-trial and `game.drpg.checkState()`; E43's fuzz of every
  request from a player's console; E39's flows; E59's windows as tests. Tests and their fixes; E39, E40, E43 and E59 are
  not marked shipped.
- **The tier-2 restore and 46 test corrections after E69 C8** (t2-restore, t2-rest): the suite's restore ends the masks
  a test left standing before the stores go back; the grid's model knows the mask (42 cases), the victim's whisper test
  reads "Someone" on Hope, and the backup's fixtures, phone against desk and E40-T3 read today's module. One new tier-2
  test, the season reset with a standing mask.
- **Tiers 0-1's bound**: 560 s to 850 s (`EVAL_MS` in run-tests.mjs and `READ_ONLY_MS` in 01-runtests), 1.5 times the
  slowest reading.
- **E26's preparation**: the fonts and their licences (above); module.json held to D1 (no `maximum`); module.zip the same
  bytes on any git configuration.
- The R-number registry regenerated after each merge by `node tools/registry.mjs --write`; tools/pl-reviewed.json
  restamped with `node tools/stale-pl.mjs --stamp` where a merge brought a line's reading of a Polish key.

## Known gaps

- **A killer behind a "?" keeps their token's actor**, so a player's browser console can still tell whose token it is;
  the interface does not (the README's sentence, the owner's yes of 14.11.2026; known leak
  `foundry-masked-token-actor`). It is a curtain, not a wall.
- **72-canary's three expected reds**, each a Foundry limit the scenario reads and names: `foundry-hidden-tokens`
  (every Token document, hidden or not, reaches every browser with its name and position), `foundry-actor-items`
  (every item a character carries reaches every browser with its name and flags) and `S17-64` (an unfound trace is a
  hidden Token document every browser holds with its position; its note and subject stay with the GM).
- **The radio sweep read no Polish**: the tree holds no Polish captures for `--pl-windows`.
- For 1.2.115: `node tools/check.mjs live` does not read the ids LIVE-R4420-01 and LIVE-113R-01/-02; docs/dev/e102/
  KEYS.json still holds four Polish tooltips as they read before 7de81166; docs/dev/e71/NEEDSCODE.md:21 quotes a stale
  planned version (outside R2001's files).
- A restore that brings a mask's row back does not settle the microphone (read off the code, not measured; t2-rest's
  question 1, left as it is).
